title: Kurukku Kalan

ingredients: Raw Banana - 1 nos, Yam/Chena - 150 g, Eastern Pepper Powder - 3/4 tsp, Eastern Turmeric Powder - ½ tsp, Coconut Grated - 1½ cup, Green Chillies - 2 or 3 nos, Few Curry Leaves, Eastern cumin seeds - ¼ tsp, Salt as required, Water - 1 cup, Curd - ½ liter, a pinch of Fenugreek Powder.
For Tampering : Coconut Oil - 2 tbsp, a pinch of Eastern Fenugreek Seeds - ¼ tsp, Dry Red Chillies - 3 to 4 nos, Few curry leaves.
method: Firstly peel, rinse, and then chop the elephant yam (suran) and raw banana) in cubes or squares.
Now transfer these veggies to a cooking pan. Add 1 cup water, 3/4 tsp pepper powder, and 1/2 tsp turmeric powder to the pan.
Once the water starts to boil, turn the flame to low. Cover and cook until the vegetables are cooked completely.
Meanwhile, let us prepare the masala. For that add 1 1/2 cup of freshly grated coconut, 1 some curry leaves, 1 or 2 green chilies, 1/2 tsp cumin powder, or 1/4 tsp cumin seeds. Crush it once.
Then add 1/2 a cup of curd from the 1/2 liter curd. Grind it to a fine paste and keep it aside.
Once the veggies are cooked, add 1/4 tsp ghee & salt as required. Mix the veggies gently.
Whisk or beat the remaining curd using a spoon or wired whisk till smooth. Using sour curd makes the dish tastier.

Add the beaten curd to the veggies. Continue stirring & bring to boil. Continuous stirring will avoid curdling formation. The gravy should be thickened for this recipe. So continue stirring until it gets thickened.
Then add the ground masala & mix it gently.
There is no need to boil the gravy after adding the masala. Once the masala gets heated up switch off the flame

title: Beef Bruschetta
subtitle: BEEF BRUSCHETTA using Eastern Meat masala

ingredients: 1 cup diced Roma tomatoes, seeded, ribs removed (about 4 medium tomatoes)
1/3 cup packed Kalamata olives, cut in half lengthwise then into 1/4-inch half moons
1/3 cup thinly sliced fresh basil leaves
method: Preheat oven to 375°F. Heat garlic, vegetable oil and olive oil in a small sauce pan over medium-low heat. Cook 8 to 10 minutes or until the garlic begins to brown. Remove from heat; set aside to cool.
Drain garlic from oil. Reserve 2 tablespoons oil for bread and 2 tablespoons oil for tomato mixture; set aside.

Cut ciabatta in half lengthwise. Slice into 18, 1/2-inch pieces; place on shallow-rimmed baking sheet. (You may have some leftover ciabatta.) Brush each piece with reserved 2 tablespoons garlic oil. Bake in 375°F oven 10 minutes. Set aside.
Chop cooled garlic and return to same sauce pan; add feta. Heat on medium heat; cook 4 to 5 minutes until cheese is melted and looks like ricotta cheese. Keep warm.

Marinate beef with eastern meat masala and salt and pepper. Place steak on grid over medium, ash-covered coals. Grill, covered, 10 to 14 minutes (over medium heat on preheated grill, covered, 12 to 16 minutes) for medium rare (145°F) to medium (160°F) doneness, turning occasionally.
Combine tomatoes, olives, basil and remaining 2 tablespoons oil in small bowl; set aside.

Spread 2 teaspoons garlic-feta mixture on each piece toasted ciabatta. Carve steak into 1/4-inch slices. Cut each slice into 1-1/2-inch pieces. Place two steak pieces on each piece ciabatta. Top with 1 tablespoon tomato mixture.

title: Béchamel Pasta

parts.heading: Step-1 Cook Macaroni
method: Macaroni - 3 Cups : Cook Macaroni as per the instructions on the packet, adding 1 tsp oil and salt. After cooking, drain left over water and run cold water over it, and drain again and keep aside.

parts.heading: Step-2 For Shredded Chicken
method: Boil the chicken with salt, pepper and water. Shred the cooked chicken into big pieces and keep aside.

parts.heading: Step-3 For Veggies & Shredded Chicken Mix
method: Saute garlic in oil with tomato paste and mix well until the oil separates.
Add all the spices with chicken stock water and mix well.
Then add all the veggies and cook for a minute.
Finally add in the shredded chicken and mix well .
Keep it closed and cook for 1-2 min in low flame.

parts.heading: Step-4 For Béchamel Sauce
method: Add the chicken cube and milk powder into the chicken stock water and whisk well.
Melt butter in a saucepan, add in the flour and stir continuously.
Cook it for two minutes till the raw smell disappears.
Now add the chicken stock water slowly and cook till it becomes a smooth sauce.
Finally add 1 cup of fresh cream and mix till it gets combined well.

parts.heading: Step-5 Layering
method: Take a greased glass dish and spread half of the chicken masala, boiled pasta & béchamel sauce.
Sprinkle some cheese, oregano and chilli flakes. Repeat to make two more layers similarly.
Bake it in a preheated oven for about 20-25 minutes at 180 degrees.

title: Spicy Chicken Kizhi
subtitle: Chicken Kizhi using Eastern Spicy Chicken Masala

parts.methodTitle: How to make Spicy Chicken Kizhi
method: Wash the chicken and add 2 table spoon eastern spicy chicken masala ,one table spoon eastern chilly powder one table spoon eastern coriander powder 1/2 table spoon eastern turmeric powder ,mix with required salt and coconut oil..keep it a side for 10 minutes.Keep an ‘urli’(traditional cookware of South)on the stove,pour enough oil to shallow fry the chicken add some curry leaves to the same,keep the chicken in a bowl,now in the same oil let's roast some onion, add enough salt ,crushed ginger garlic &green chilly,later add the tomatoes and eastern masalas,eastern crushed chilly, also add the fried chicken to it.Close the lid and cook it for 10 mins in low flame.Now add coconut milk to it and off the stove. Tie these cooked chicken in a piece of heated banana leaf and tie it and put it on a frying pan or tawa pour a little water on the tawa to get it steamed..Eastern spicy chicken kizhi is now ready.

title: Chicken Pockets
subtitle: Chicken Pockets using Eastern Chicken Masala

method: In a pan, sauté onions in oil till golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste, green chilli and salt. Sauté for few minutes.
Add Eastern Chicken Masala and Eastern Garam Masala. Sauté for a while.
Add chopped chicken and cook until done.
Add in carrot and sauté for a while.
Chicken stuffing is ready and keep aside.
Place two samosa sheets in the form of a cross, place the stuffing in the middle portion and fold in the sides to form a pocket.
Make pockets until the stuffing finishes.
Fry these pockets in hot oil and serve hot with tomato sauce.

note: Note: Can also use the filling to form other shapes using samosa sheets.

title: Baked Chicken & Macaroni Casserole
subtitle: Chicken Casserole using Eastern Elbow Macaroni

ingredients: Eastern Macaroni – 2 cup, Butter – 4 tbsp, All-purpose flour – ¼ cup, Black pepper – 4 tsp, Garlic – 8 pods, Cheddar cheese (Shredded) – 4 cup, Onion – 1 nos, Cooked chicken (boneless cubes) – 2 cup, Broccoli florets – 1 cup, Milk – 3 cup, Breadcrumbs – 1 cup.
method: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees and lightly grease a square baking dish.
Cook the macaroni to al dente, until cooked through but firm to bite, 8 minutes . Drain and set aside.

At the same time, melt butter in a sauce pan over medium heat .Add flour salt, and pepper and stir until smooth, about 5 minutes. Pour in milk slowly, while stirring Continuously .Continue to cook and stir until mixture is smooth and bubbling, about 5 minutes, making sure the milk doesn’t burn.
Add Cheddar cheese and stir until melted, 2 to 4 minutes.
Drain macaroni and fold into the sauce until coated, add the cooked chicken, cooked broccoli florets, sautéed onion and garlic and season it with salt and pepper.
Transfer it into a serving tray, sprinkle breadcrumbs on the top layer to cover the mixture. And bake it in a preheated oven for 20 minutes and serve hot.

title: Nutella Nawabi Samai
subtitle: Nutella Nawabi Samai using Eastern Roasted Vermicelli

parts.methodTitle: How to make Nutella Nawabi Samai
method: Add 200gm Condensed Milk into 500ml warm milk. Make a mixture of 3-4 tsp cornflour and warm milk, add it to milk and bring to boil. Once boiled, set aside.

Similarly, make a mixture of custard powder and warm milk and add it to 500ml boiling milk & 200gm Condensed Milk. Once thickened turn off the flame and set aside. Add 300 gm nutella to 100ml fresh cream and mix well.

Toss the Eastern Roasted Vermicelli in 100gm butter and add crushed nuts(optional). Now add 5-6 tsp of milk powder and powdered sugar each and set aside. Skip this step if you are not a fan of too much sweetness.

Now to the final step, spread one third of the Eastern Roasted Vermicelli on the setting dish. Now pour over the cornflour mix. Similarly, set a second layer of Eastern Roasted Vermicelli and pour over the custard mix. Lastly, spread across the last layer of Eastern Roasted Vermicelli and pour over the nutella mix. Now add toppings of your choice.
NUTELLA NAWABI SAMAI is now READYY!!

title: Mohabath Ka Sharbath
subtitle: Mohabath Ka Sharbath using Eastern Roasted Vermicelli

ingredients: Eastern Roasted Vermicelli – 3 tbsp (cooked), Milk – 2 cups, Watermelon cubes – 1 cup, Condensed milk – 1 tbsp, Ice cubes – as required, Chia seeds – 1tbsp (soaked), Nuts – for garnish.
method: In a mixing bowl, add ice cubes and milk.
Add cooked Eastern Roasted Vermicelli
Add watermelon cubes, soaked chia seeds and condensed milk
Mix well
Top with nuts to serve.

title: Meethi Vermicelli
subtitle: Meethi Seviyan using Eastern Roasted Vermicelli

method: Heat a pan and then add 1 tbsp ghee.
Let the ghee melt and then add 1 cup of semiya.
On a low to medium flame, with frequent stirring roast the semiya for 1 minute
Add all the chopped dry nuts and raisins. Stir them nicely.
Lower the flame and pour 2 cups of milk.
Stir and mix very well. Then continue to stir for 2 to 3 minutes.
Now add sugar. Keep stirring the mixture.
Add milk powder
Sprinkle cardamom powder and stir well.
The mixture will start thickening and the vermicelli will begin to absorb milk, and cook till the milk get absorbed.Switch off the flame.
Can add fruits for garnishing

title: Pish Kesari
subtitle: Pish Kesari with Eastern Roasted Vermicelli

method: Roast vermicelli in ghee and add hot water to cook. While cooking add salt, cardamom and rose water. Once vermicelli is cooked and the water is reduced by half add color and mix well. Add condensed milk to it and cook the water get reduced fully. Add extra ghee to the mixture and transfer to a greased baking tray. Decorates with crushed green pistachios. Cool down till it reach the room temperature. Perfect pish kesari is ready to serve.

title: Roasted Vermicelli Payasam
subtitle: Semiya Payasam using Eastern Roated Vermicelli

method: Boil milk in a heavy bottom vessel.
Add Vermicelli and cook for 8 minutes on low flame.
Add sugar and cook for 5 minutes and add cardamom powder.
Switch off the flame
Heat ghee in a pan and add cashews and raisin and fry
Add it into the payasam

title: Vermicelli Custard
subtitle: Fruit Custard with Eastern Roasted Vermicelli

method: Boil 4 cups of a milk in a pan with saffron
Once boiled well, add Eastern roasted vermicelli to it.
Add sugar and stir well
Boil the mixture for 7 minutes
Mix custard powder with ½ cup milk and add it to the boiling mixture.
Refrigerate the mixture for 2 hours
Take a dessert glass and start layering:
Chia seeds 2tbsp • Custard vermicelli 1/4th cup
Pomegranate • Chopped Grapes
Chopped Mango • Chopped Apple • Chopped nuts
Vermicelli custard 1/4th cup • Tutti Frutti • Cherry
